regions.region: upper title and two-column introductory prose
regions.finding: Title, motivation, biological context, and prose summaries of three prior synthetic strategies; prior work was classified as literature examples and not as experiments performed in this paper.
Natural carbazole structures and an R-group/name/activity table; this is a compound overview with no reaction arrow or experimental condition, so no experiment record was created.

regions.region: lower-right prior-art discussion continuing toward Scheme 2
regions.finding: Witulski, Knölker, and Kuethe routes are cited work. Reported regioisomer ratios and explicit oxidant equivalents were retained only in literature-example records; no present-paper batch is claimed.

unresolved: The cited routes are condensed summaries; their original experimental quantities, time, full yields, and complete substrate identities are not available on this page.
Scheme 1 structures were not converted to verified SMILES because they are contextual natural-product depictions, not reaction participants in a reported batch.

regions.finding: Three explicitly reported prior-literature strategies were separated as literature examples, including the 3.8:1 and 1.4:1 regioisomer ratios and visible Pd/Cu/HOAc or P(OEt)3 conditions.

The upper PtCl2 arrow is a generic previously reported carbazole synthesis and the lower Au arrow is the present strategic proposal; the variable-R strategy was retained as one general_scheme rather than fabricated substrate-scope experiments.

regions.region: lower-left Scheme 4 and adjacent protecting-group prose
regions.finding: Two independent 2a-to-3a debenzylation conditions were extracted (MeLi, 53%; tBuOK/DMSO/THF/O2, 87%). General statements that N-Tosyl and N-Boc substrates failed lack batch-specific conditions and were not inflated into exact experiments.

regions.region: right column and Scheme 5 discussion continued on page 3
regions.finding: Preparation and cyclization of 1b, bromination, N-debenzylation, Suzuki coupling, demethylation routes, and all explicitly named failed protocols were separated by arrow/condition. The PtCl2 and AuCl 1b-to-2b entries were linked to their page-4 batch details instead of duplicated.

unresolved: Most Scheme 4/5 arrows omit one or more of reaction scale, atmosphere, time, workup, purification, or yield basis; absent values were not inferred.
The decomposition products from path A and the materials observed in failed path B/Suzuki trials are unidentified.
No SI file was explicitly provided or associated.

regions.finding: All labeled arrows a–h were transcribed as independent experiments or multi-stage records, including catalyst loadings, equivalents, temperatures, times, yields, two-step 60% yield, and one-pot 66% yield. Crossed paths A/B were linked to the distinct failed condition records described on page 2.

Allenol 1c preparation, AuCl cyclization, debenzylation, and six downstream arrows c–h were separated. The direct 3c-to-ester two-step route and clausine-N methylation route were kept distinct despite converging on clauszoline-L.

regions.region: lower prose with overall route yields
regions.finding: Overall yields and step counts summarize complete routes and were not duplicated as individual batch outcomes because the corresponding arrow yields were already extracted.
Natural-product structures proposed as future/general targets; no experimental arrow or result is shown, so no experiment records were created.

unresolved: Many arrows do not report reaction scale, exact time, atmosphere, workup, purification, or yield measurement basis.
Complex structure drawings are legible by label but remain unverified as machine SMILES.
Overall-route yields were not treated as independent experiments.

regions.region: upper-left Experimental Section, PtCl2 preparation of 2b
regions.finding: Detailed PtCl2 batch for 1b-to-2b was merged into the Scheme 5 PtCl2 record: reagent masses/mmol, 2 mL toluene, dry Schlenk/N2, 24 h at room temperature, TLC, evaporation, chromatography (20:1), product mass, and 61% isolated yield.
Distinct AuCl batch for 1b-to-2b was merged into the Scheme 5 AuCl record: AuCl and 1b masses/mmol, 10 mL toluene, room temperature, 8 h, product mass, 81% yield, and 40:1 eluent.
No additional present-paper experiment is reported. The acknowledgement states that 3c and clauszoline-K results were reproduced but does not define a new condition set or batch.

unresolved: The AuCl paragraph does not explicitly restate atmosphere, workup, or the word 'column chromatography'; those details were not inherited from the separate PtCl2 typical procedure.
The printed product characterization was not modeled as reaction conditions/outcomes beyond product identity and mass.
